core_obligations: Choose surjective etale charts over the base and source so that etale-local properties may be checked on the schemes-side thickening lemma.

proof_roadmap.step: Choose surjective etale charts and reduce the etale-local items to the schemes case.
Handle the differential criterion Omega_{X/Y} = 0 iff Omega_{X'/Y'} = 0.
Finish the closed immersion, immersion and finiteness cases.

difficulty_reason: The spaces-side form of the thickening-transfer lemma: for a morphism of thickenings of algebraic spaces over S with X = Y x_{Y'} X' and X in X' a finite order thickening, eleven properties transfer between f and f'. The proof chooses surjective etale charts to pass down to the schemes case for most items, then handles the differential criterion and the immersion and finiteness cases directly, using the identification of the sheaf of differentials and the structure of finite order thickenings. Reducing a spaces-side statement to a scheme-side one through charts is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 2066-2146.

dedup.scope: Cross-chapter same-name pair compared by hypothesis and conclusion: this is the algebraic-spaces form of lemma-thicken-property-morphisms-cartesian in stacks-more-morphisms. Since the schemes version is the special case, the algebraic-spaces form is the more general one to keep under the dedup rule. Compared against all focused-seeds task.json, PREPARATION_WORKLIST.jsonl, and public intervals for spaces-more-morphisms.tex.

compared.difference: Hypothesis difference: the schemes version thickens the base target over schemes; this one is stated for thickenings of algebraic spaces. Conclusion difference: none, the same eleven properties transfer in both.
